material.title: Synthetic Robotics releases a timestamp synchronization utility
material.sourceName: Synthetic fixture - not a real source
material.bodyOriginal: This is a synthetic programming fixture, not real news. Synthetic Robotics released a ROS 2 timestamp synchronization utility with source code under Apache-2.0 and documented hardware wiring. The report compares timestamp residuals on one stated IMU and camera setup; it does not test navigation accuracy or long-term reliability.
